cultural.vision_reason: The photograph documents a Plain Anga village with thatched-roof circular buildings and a man in traditional dress seated in the foreground, matching the claimed ethnicity and depicting their daily life/settlement.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, view across Plain Anga village. Circular, thatched-roof buildings with plants growing over roofs. Adult male sitting in foreground, wearing cloth around lower body, wrist-ornament, smoking a pipe.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
